thread:
Ash: Quick sync — Bali edge expansion. Need final ownership for routing policy, KMS config, and DB replica residency. Targeting 2025-05-15 go-live. Who's owning what?
Mira: I can take routing policy + proxy ACLs. Will own the Terraform PRs.
Ben: I own KMS/key rotation. Legal still needs to sign off on cross-region key usage — pinging @Jess.
Jess: Legal is on it, expect clearance by EOD Thu if nothing else pops. FYI: data residency memo raised one question about backups.
Sam: For DB replica residency, we have two options: local read replica in Bali (cost + ops) or geo-read via regional replica in JKT. Preference?
Mira: leaning local read replica for latency-sensitive traffic. Ops effort: +2 infra engineers for runbooks.
Ben: note: if we do local replica we need CMK in region and RBAC change. Example terraform snippet I'm working on:
```
resource "aws_kms_key" "bali_cmk" {
  description = "Bali edge CMK for DB replica and proxy"
  policy      = file("kms-policy-bali.json")
  enable_key_rotation = true
}
```
Sam: thanks — I'll review that PR (#4827) today. Who can review the routing PR?
Mira: @Ash can you take the routing PR? it's #4832, adds proxy routes + egress policy.
Ash: on it, will do a quick pass by noon.
infra-oncall: smoke window available 2025-05-12 02:00-06:00 UTC (low traffic). Recommend scheduling canary then.
Mira: canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h, health checks + latency SLO metrics + fallback to JKT. I'll add a dashboard tile.
Ben: legal note: backups crossing regions need explicit retention clause. Jess — can you confirm minimal retention we can advertise?
Jess: legal confirms retention min = 30 days for user data; backups to be flagged and excluded from certain analytics. I'll post the snippet to the ticket.
Ash: action items: (1) Mira — complete routing PR #4832 + canary dashboard (due 2025-05-08), (2) Ben — finalize CMK TF + PR #4827 (due 2025-05-07), (3) Sam — DB replica ops runbook draft (due 2025-05-09), (4) Jess — legal sign-off + retention clause in ticket (due 2025-05-08).
Sam: noted. I'll start runbook and drop it in the repo under /ops/runbooks/bali-replica.md.
Mira: pinging reviewers: @Ash @Ben please ack when you review. :thumbsup:
Ash: acked, leaving inline comments on #4832 now.
Ben: left some KMS policy comments on #4827 — small fix then approve.
deploy-bot: Deploy check: infra PRs passing CI (2/3). Waiting on policy-lint in #4827.
Mira: will fix policy-lint today.
Jess: legal uploaded clause to ticket. all set from Legal side pending final infra changes.
Ash: great — once PRs merged, schedule canary with infra-oncall. I'll update the cutover doc and ping release channel.
Mira: thanks everyone — closing loop here, will post a short status update in the project board when PRs merge. :rocket:
